result.title: RegimeCouncil: Paired-Evidence Routing For Memory Conflict Governance In LLM Agents
result.summary: Language agents rely on long-term memory to personalize responses across extended interactions, yet stored facts quietly go stale as the world changes, and an agent often learns that using memory hurt only through delayed feedback after acting on an outdated record. Before the memory store is updated, how far should that negative feedback propagate: should it suppress memory use only on future queries for that same fact (a local policy), or also across other stored facts (a global policy)? Existing memory systems implicitly fix one of these two sharing scopes at design time. We formulate this online scope choice under hidden validity and delayed feedback as memory conflict governance, and prove that neither fixed policy is sufficient on its own. We then propose RegimeCouncil, a lightweight paired-evidence router that retains both scopes as advisors and arbitrates between them online without retraining the LLM. Using revealed comparisons between answering with memory and answering without memory (the no-memory anchor), a Local Advisor tracks the latest outcome on the queried fact alone, while a Global Advisor pools recent outcomes across all stored facts. A Meta Governor follows the Local Advisor by default to avoid cross-fact interference and switches to the Global Advisor only when global pooling accumulates a strictly positive recent utility margin, guaranteeing finite-time switching under delayed feedback. Across LongMemEval update streams and real-world historical drift on TempLAMA and TAQA with Qwen3-30B-A3B and GPT-4o, RegimeCouncil outperforms the better fixed-scope policy by 5.2-7.3 points on primary disagreement episodes and across all 30 held-out settings, while ablations show that removing any of its three modules reduces accuracy by 2-7 points.

AI.brief_summary: 论文把记忆失效后负反馈应局限于同一事实还是跨事实传播，形式化为 memory conflict governance，提出 RegimeCouncil：以 Local/Global 两个 advisor 加 Meta Governor 在线仲裁共享范围，不重训 LLM，并在 LongMemEval 更新流与真实历史漂移数据上验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 「保留两种策略、依延迟反馈在线仲裁切换」的结构可能与 LVR 中是否采信 latent 内容、以及 THINK/STOP 的证据与计算取舍形成类比，但论文不含视觉推理，迁移可行性待核查。
